name: Northeast Face

text.overview: A more remote alternative to the standard route, gained from the glacier below the peak's northeast face and climbing mixed snow and rock — including a large, ~45-degree snow gully — via mostly class 3 with occasional class 4 rock to the summit.

lastAnswer: nothing new. Opened: Wikipedia American Border Peak (lists only SE face, no access), stevensong.com report (standard SE route from Twin Lakes; only a photo caption of NE-face icefalls). SummitPost/Mountaineers/CascadeClimbers 403. No opened page describes the NE face or its start; Twin Lakes (USFS 48.951763,-121.635355) vs Tomyhoi/Yellow Aster lot (48.943426,-121.662795) both in use for the peak; leading but unproven candidate Twin Lakes.

name: West Slope from Black Giant Pass

text.description: A remote peak reached off the John Muir Trail near Muir Pass; leave the trail for Black Giant Pass, then walk up about half a mile of loose rock to the summit. The east-side approach over Echo Col from Lake Sabrina adds class 3 and possible snow.

officialCandidates.name: BIG PINE CREEK SO FORK TH
Big Pine Creek North Fork Trail Trailhea

lastAnswer: Nothing new. Opened peaksforfreaks 2013 (Lake Sabrina TH 37.213617,-118.610096 via Echo Col, then JMT to Helen Lake, west slope) and wacziarg 2019 (Lake Sabrina via Echo Col, Black Giant west slope on return). But route text calls the Echo Col approach the east-side variant and the main approach is off the JMT near Muir Pass, which could be South Lake (Bishop Pass), North Lake or Sabrina. Peakery lists west slope but names no trailhead. No page ties 'West Slope from Black Giant Pass' to one start. Leads: USFS SABRINA LAKE TH 37.213605,-118.610013; South Lake TH 37.169305,-118.565813. highsierratopix 403.
